changelog: v0.7.0: 1) Non-blocking UI during Avatar Speech: zero Quest CPU overhead with remote audio playback & WebAssembly event loop yielding; 2) Live Mode Full-Duplex AEC & Intelligent Barge-In: microsecond barge-in detection allows cutting off the avatar naturally while speaking in Smart AEC mode; 3) Parallel Backend TTS Pipelining: concurrent multi-core synthesis on PC server with sub-300ms first-chunk streaming and zero inter-sentence latency; 4) Selective Model Loading: bypass on-device Whisper and Piper downloads when connected to PC server to save 300MB+ RAM while preserving offline standalone capability.
